2. ELIGIBLE PRODUCTS AND OFFERS

Qualified customers who register during the pre-order period and complete an eligible purchase during the claiming period receive ₱1,000 off. Customers qualifying for the additional Home Credit offer may receive a total product-price discount of ₱2,000, subject to final approved conditions.

3. PRE-ORDER REGISTRATION AND RESERVATION

  • Visit a participating store from December 11 to 17, 2026 and select an eligible variant.
  • Scan the official Pre-Order QR Code with assistance from an authorized store representative.
  • Complete the registration form with full name, contact number, selected variant and designated claiming store, plus necessary registration details.
  • A reservation payment of ₱500 is required to secure a pre-order. The exact amount and whether it is fixed by variant or customer-selected must be confirmed before filing.

Reservation payment will be credited toward the final purchase amount. The approved mechanics must specify refund and cancellation rules before customer collection begins.

  • After reservation payment, receive and retain the official payment acknowledgment and unique pre-order reference for claiming. Registration alone does not constitute a completed purchase or guarantee financing approval.

4. CLAIMING AND PURCHASE

  • Visit the designated participating store from December 18 to 20, 2026.
  • Present the pre-order confirmation for validation through the official Claiming QR Code or designated system.
  • After successful verification, receive the ₱1,000 pre-order discount on an eligible purchase.
  • Customers choosing Home Credit must complete the financing application and receive approval under the partner’s final terms to qualify for the additional ₱1,000 discount.
  • Apply the paid reservation amount toward the final purchase price (not as an additional discount). Settle the remaining balance, receive the unit and sales invoice, and record the claim in the designated Infinix reporting system.

5. DISCOUNT COMPUTATION

Regular payment
Confirmed SRP − ₱1,000 = promotional product price
Qualified Home Credit
Confirmed SRP − ₱1,000 − ₱1,000 = promotional product price
Financing disclosure
Applicable interest, fees, installment schedule and total amount payable disclosed separately under Home Credit terms

6. GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS

  • Valid only for eligible variants at listed participating stores during the stated dates.
  • One valid registration may be redeemed once for one eligible unit; verification is required.
  • The discount is not exchangeable for cash or separately redeemable.
  • Home Credit discount is contingent on partner eligibility, financing approval and confirmed promotional conditions.
  • Cannot be combined with other offers unless the approved mechanics expressly allow it.
  • Availability and allocation by participating store must be disclosed; stock shortages and unclaimed registrations will be handled under the final published customer remedy and reservation policy [confirm before filing].
  • Registration data will be processed for administration and verification under the applicable privacy notice and data protection laws.
  • Any change to approved mechanics is subject to applicable DTI requirements.

Per DTI Fair Trade Permit No. FTEB-272984 Series of 2026
